init.description: Choose what you want to do. Orphaned dashboard settings found: {orphans}.

settings.title: Dwains Dashboard Settings
settings.description: These settings are stored in dwains-dashboard/configs/settings.yaml.

data.area_binary_sensor_device_classes: Binary sensor values below area name
data.disable_masonry: Cards in rows of equal height (no masonry)

data_description.area_sensor_device_classes: Select the sensor device classes that should be shown on area tiles below the area name. Select nothing to show nothing.
data_description.area_binary_sensor_device_classes: Select binary sensor device classes that should be shown as status summaries after the normal sensor values. Select nothing to show nothing.
data_description.area_view_grouping_mode: Per client keeps the current browser/device setting. Enabled or disabled enforces the grouping globally from the server.
data_description.area_floor_grouping_mode: Per client keeps the current browser/device setting. Enabled or disabled enforces area grouping by floor globally from the server.
data_description.disable_masonry: Favorites and the area view normally place each card at its natural height without gaps (masonry). Turn this on for rows in which all cards have the same height, as in earlier versions.
data_description.house_information_entries: Choose what the status bar at the top of the homepage may show. An entry only appears while something of its kind is on, open or detected.

import_settings.title: Import settings
import_settings.description:
Replaces **all** Dwains Dashboard settings (areas, entities, cards, more pages, blueprints and the dashboard settings) with the content of an export file made with *Export settings*.

The current settings are moved to `dwains-dashboard/backups/` first, so nothing is lost.

error.confirm_required: Turn on the switch to confirm the cleanup.
error.confirm_required_import: Turn on the switch to confirm the import.
error.invalid_archive: This file is not a Dwains Dashboard export or it is damaged. Nothing was changed.
error.upload_failed: The upload did not arrive. Please select the file again.

abort.nothing_to_clean: No orphaned dashboard settings found. Everything is clean.
abort.cleanup_done: Removed {removed} entries. A backup of all touched files is in `{backup}`.
abort.export_done:
Exported {files} files.

Download: **{download}**

The link is valid for 10 minutes. The archive also stays in `{folder}` (the five newest exports are kept).
abort.export_failed: The settings cannot be exported: {error}. Nothing was written.
abort.import_done: Imported {files} files. The dashboard reloads with the imported settings. The previous settings are in `{backup}`.
